rationale: OXM has gapped down nearly 18% on no available news context, making the catalyst and thus directional persistence unknowable — the stock could be in a dead-cat bounce (bearish) or a genuine stabilization (bullish), but I have no edge distinguishing between them. The 5-min ATR of $0.12 is disproportionately small relative to the 85-bps bid-ask spread, meaning friction would consume most of any short-term move, and the stock is already 67.9% off its intraday low after a large bounce from $28.20, reducing asymmetric upside for a long. Given the wide spread, zero news context, no comparable historical setups, and an already-negative daily P&L, the expected value of any entry is near zero with meaningful tail risk.
